packageRules.description: SDK upgrades are deliberate: use Expo's upgrade guide and `npx expo install --fix`, never let these bump on their own or individually. React and the react-native-* peers listed here are all pinned to versions the Expo SDK itself dictates.
Every action in .github/workflows/ci.yml is pinned to a commit SHA; keep it that way as Renovate bumps them.

Only dev-dependency patch updates automerge, and only once CI has passed on the PR — branch protection (scripts/setup-branch-protection.sh) is what actually enforces the 'after CI passes' half of this.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Vulnerability fixes are raised immediately regardless of the weekly schedule above.
